snippet.title: Crowsworn - Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
Crowsworn is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Game Pass! Explore a dark world inhabited by men and monsters in this action packed platformer. Lay waste to the monsters that stand in your way with a wide array of stylish combat maneuvers, as you attempt to unravel the truth behind the curse of Fearanndal.

Crowsworn is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.
